notes: Background: mid-market analytics SaaS; goal is in-product assistant + fast doc search for onboarding and support articles.
Initial approach: start on Hosted API to validate UX and token mix; if 30-60 day trial meets p99 SLA and cost targets, they will move to Dedicated reserved capacity.
Key quote (CTO): 'Primary ask is predictable p99 latency under 150ms for short chat flows and sub-50ms embedding lookups; we can tolerate slightly higher for long-form summarization.'
Security: baseline SOC2 + SSO (Okta) required; legal asked for data residency in US only for first year. KMS integration required for Private later but not for first Dedicated purchase.
Product constraints: multi-tenant product, per-customer conversational contexts (prefix caching desirable), want routing policy to fall back to smaller models during spikes.
Commercial: finance has a preference for 12-month committed reserved capacity if ROI shows >35% reduction in per-token spend vs Hosted.

Observed during Hosted trial (metrics): avg QPS 12, peak QPS 48 during weekday peak; typical effective concurrency 3-5, observed peak concurrency 14; avg tokens/request ~420 (prompt ~160 / completion ~260).
Token mix: ~70% short chat (<=256 tokens), 20% long summaries (>=1000 tokens), 10% embeddings/rerank (small vectors).
Hosting notes: trial used region us-east-1, they want option for us-west failover and EU data residency later.
POC feedback: engineering liked continuous batching improvements; they requested explicit guidance on KV cache sizing per user and checkpoint migration during model rollouts.
Pricing conversation: asked for 3 pricing scenarios - minimal (burstable), target (steady dedicated), aggressive (headroom for growth).
Action items from 2026-02-18 call: Redwood to send Dedicated sizing worksheet, provide example cost calc, and schedule SE deep dive on KV cache and routing policies (week of 2026-02-23).

dedicated_capacity_sizing_notes: Observed trial baseline: sustained 12 QPS, peak 48 QPS; average tokens/request 420 => baseline tokens/sec ~5040 (12 * 420).
Target steady-state for Year 1: plan for 40 QPS steady with 120 QPS headroom for spikes; anticipate average concurrency 6-10 during business hours.
Suggested Dedicated starting config: 2x A30-equivalent nodes (or 1x A100-80GB equivalent) configured with 8 concurrent model workers and continuous batching; target p99 goal <150ms for short flows.
Capacity margins: provision for sustained KV-cache resident context (avg 3k tokens/user) — recommend additional memory-backed cache layer and 20% capacity overhead for canary rollouts.

Token mix impact: long summaries (~20% of traffic) dominate token consumption; recommend separate routing to larger sequence-optimized instances for summary jobs to avoid impacting short-chat latency.

Throughput forecast (12 months): conservative projection -> steady QPS 40 => ~40*420*3600*24*30 ~ 32B tokens/month (estimate); optimistic growth (x3) pushes tokens to ~96B/month, recommend tiered commit pricing.
Cost levers discussed: aggressive quantization for summarization models, prefix caching for repeated prompts, and batching windows tuned to keep p99 under SLO without sacrificing cost.
Engineering ask: provide a Dedicated sizing worksheet with explicit GPU-hour vs tokens mapping and recommended autoscale burst policies (requested by 2026-03-02).
